summary: Block puzzle: drag blocks into the tray. No rotation, one solution.
description:
Block Puzzle & Conquer is a calm logic game with a single rule: fit every block into the tray. Blocks never rotate and each level has exactly one solution, so there is nothing to guess and nothing to grind. You look, you think, you place.

Drag a block anywhere, even across other blocks. Every empty spot is always reachable, so you can never get stuck. The only thing between you and the solution is your own reasoning.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
- Free Hints: a helping hand whenever you need one
- Classic: just you and the blocks
- Extreme: the shape of the tray is hidden, work it out from the blocks
- Time Attack: solve as many puzzles as you can before the clock runs out

THREE DIFFICULTIES, ENDLESS PUZZLES
- Easy, Medium and Hard, each with endless levels
- Extra packs of 500 hand-picked puzzles
- The classic packs from the original game, for players who remember them

MADE TO BE LOOKED AT
- Six themes: Wood, Forest, Paper, Graphite, Sky and Parchment
- Crisp blocks at any screen size, soft shadows, rounded corners
- A little celebration after every solved level

ALSO
- Leaderboards and achievements through Google Play Games
- A built-in tutorial that shows a level being solved
- Works offline, plays in portrait or landscape

Block Puzzle & Conquer is free to play. Questions or ideas? Write to admin@mtoy.biz
